title: A Museum Brochure
text:
Anna found a brochure about a museum at the train station. The brochure had many colour photos of old paintings. It said the museum is open every day except Monday.

The brochure also showed a map of the town. The entry ticket costs ten euros, and children can go in for free. Anna decided to visit the museum on Saturday.

questions.text: Where did Anna find the brochure?
How much does the entry ticket cost?
Why did Anna probably choose Saturday for her visit?
options: The museum is closed on Saturday
The brochure told her not to go on other days
She does not like museums on weekends

questions.text: What can we guess about the purpose of the brochure?
options: To make people want to visit the museum
To teach people how to paint
To warn people about bad weather

vocabulary.definition: a small booklet with pictures and information about a place or service
a small paper or card that allows you to enter a place or travel
a building where people can see art or historical objects

paragraph_translations: Anna znalazła broszurę o muzeum na dworcu kolejowym. Broszura miała wiele kolorowych zdjęć starych obrazów. Pisało w niej, że muzeum jest otwarte każdego dnia oprócz poniedziałku.
Broszura pokazywała też mapę miasta. Bilet wstępu kosztuje dziesięć euro, a dzieci mogą wejść za darmo. Anna postanowiła odwiedzić muzeum w sobotę.
